name: cublas_cublasDasum_v2
description: Faithfully extracted from KernelGenBench cuBLAS test_cublasDasum_v2.py. Double-precision absolute-sum result = sum(|x[::incx][:n]|) via the real cuBLAS baseline (which uses a gemm fallback internally). x storage length is n*incx as in the test. result is a preallocated (1,) float64 tensor and is the returned output (fully overwritten, beta=0). reference returns result. Requires kernelgenbench + cuBLAS at eval time.
